_meta.description: 400+ verified cultural, behavioral and socioeconomic data points for Denmark. Covers daily routines (hygge culture!), spending, social norms (Janteloven, #1 global trust), business culture (world-best work-life balance, MitID), religion (45% non-religious), digital behavior, education (free university), housing, food & lifestyle (smørrebrød), trust & governance (CPI #1 globally), and regional variations (Copenhagen vs Jutland).
sources: DREAM (Danish Research Institute for Economic Analysis and Modelling)
